title: Server-side HMAC signing secret compiled into the public browser bundle
impact: FALSE "server-side" label; computeHMAC is not real HMAC; the fake "Backend Authorization Middleware" chain is the authorization layer in demo mode; P0 the moment it is wired up
fix: delete SERVER_SIGNING_SECRET/computeHMAC/generateToken/verifyToken/setCookie or gate behind isDemoMode(); do not "rotate" a bundle secret

title: POST /api/users creates live accounts whose password is the constant printed on the login page
impact: 201 with no password key -> live Postgres admin authenticated by 'Apoorva@2026' (demoUsers.ts:5), globally known, never rotating, no first-login change requirement; 200 login confirmed in Pass C round 3
fix: Drop the "?? DEMO_PASSWORD" default; require password min:8; gate the admin route so DEMO_PASSWORD never reaches server code

title: Alerts/notifications/escalations specs declare no permissions and "present" scope skips null-field checks
impact: INSTITUTION_ADMIN/EVC_MEMBER create national alerts and platform-wide notices (201); raisedBy accepts "Automated SLA Monitor" verbatim; caller-chosen audit provenance; no audit rows on these writes
fix: give the 3 specs real permissions (alerts.manage, notifications.publish, escalations.resolve); require central role when both jurisdiction fields null; never accept AUTOMATED_RAISER from body

title: WITHDRAWN example: generic PUT writing stage "Final Approval"/status "Approved" on AICTE/2026/12869
impact: Round-4 in-script claim withdrawn: transcript prints 403 and row stayed Scrutiny/Re-scrutiny|Returned|v1; the applications two-way guard holds; L4-03 must use P-31/P-33 instead

title: No security response headers anywhere (CSP, X-Frame-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy, HSTS)
impact: No CSP + unframed login/approval UI: any stored XSS = session theft; approve/reject clicks frameable; measured on :8081 in Pass C none of the five headers present on SPA or API; iframe test not run
fix: One app.use after cors: CSP (default-src 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none' + fonts sources), X-Frame-Options DENY, Referrer-Policy same-origin, Permissions-Policy, COOKIE_SECURE default on

title: Empty CORS allowlist falls back to trusting any localhost port with credentialed reads AND writes
impact: localhost:9999 gets ACAO + Allow-Credentials:true and OPTIONS allows DELETE; ports are same-site so Lax cookie is sent; Pass C nuance: foreign Origin POST gets 403 ORIGIN_NOT_ALLOWED (guard works), so wording is "any localhost port is trusted"
fix: Empty allowlist -> deny by default, allow only exact request Host origin; set APP_ORIGIN in docker-compose.yml

title: No CSV formula-injection guard in exports opened by regulators in Excel
impact: escapeCsvValue only quotes/doubles "; no =/+/-/@/tab/CR filtering; institution/applicant names, undertaking text, audit details flow into reports (Reports.tsx:120, GenerateReportModal.tsx:65) -> =HYPERLINK/=cmd payloads execute
fix: prefix ' (or space-wrap) strings starting = + - @ \\t \\r in escapeCsvValue; add one vitest case per prefix

title: Assistant status endpoint unauthenticated; chat anonymous in demo mode
impact: GET /api/assistant/status leaks provider/model/isConfigured to anonymous callers (confirmed in Postgres mode); with a GEMINI key demo chat = anonymous paid-LLM use, caller picks role framing; Postgres mode unauth chat -> 401
fix: gate status with requireSession/verifyCaller (or fold isConfigured into /api/health); refuse demo chat when key set unless ALLOW_DEMO_ASSISTANT=1

title: Login-throttle bucket Map is never evicted (unbounded growth) - server/rateLimit.ts:11
impact: recordLoginFailure inserts; nothing deletes; Pass C P-14: 80+ failed logins moved docker stats 153.5->153.2 MiB, so a long-horizon concern, not a demonstrated leak; restart-reset remains static inference, not runtime-tested
fix: reuse createRateLimiter from aiGuard.ts (it prunes >5000) or sweep expired keys on a timer

title: Password/role changes do not revoke live sessions; no idle timeout
impact: Pass C round 3 P-07: after reset the old cookie still gets GET /api/snapshot 200 (deactivation does cut off, 401); 12h/30-day cookies stay valid post-rotation; P-26: 15 sessions/5 users, no concurrency cap
fix: revokedAt-stamp or deleteMany sessions for the user in the admin PUT + audit newState; add lastUsedAt idle cap (~8h for non-rememberMe)

title: Session table is never pruned: 65 rows, 0 expired; no deleteMany on sessions anywhere in server/
impact: Accumulating live sessions; only deleteMany calls in server/ delete assistant messages (routes/assistant.ts:73,95)

title: Real external Supabase tenant URL is the compiled-in fallback
impact: Tenant ref shipped in bundle and pushed to remote; silent fallback - supabase build without VITE_SUPABASE_URL talks to that tenant instead of refusing; not probed per audit rules, static only
fix: const supabaseUrl = import.meta.env.VITE_SUPABASE_URL ?? '' ; construct client lazily inside isSupabaseConfigured checks

title: SSE is a global channel: changed-table names visible to every signed-in role
impact: Frames carry only {tables,rev} but tables a role cannot read (users, rolePermissions, auditLogs) leak as an activity oracle; client refetches whole snapshot (L8-04) amplifying load; no clients-size cap

title: Assistant history accepts client-chosen primary keys
impact: Duplicate or other-user-owned id -> P2002 -> 409; no cross-user write (userId-scoped) but one account can permanently squat a UUID and break another's save

title: Demo mode fabricates session/audit provenance IPs
impact: ipAddress '10.24.1.84' hardcoded into in-browser session registry; every client audit row stamped '127.0.0.1' (:781); fictional provenance in a trail sold as tamper-evident reads as tampering

title: COOKIE_SECURE defaults to off and is unset in the Postgres overlay
impact: A TLS deployment that forgets the env var ships HttpOnly but non-Secure cookies; Pass C P-26 measured HttpOnly; SameSite=Lax with no Secure (correct over plain http locally)
fix: fold into L4-04 fix (default on unless NODE_ENV=development)

title: Checked and not a finding: /api/admin/reset is double-gated
impact: role !== 'SUPER_ADMIN' AND env kill switch ALLOW_DEMO_RESET !== '1' both required

title: POST /documents/:id/verify has no outcome branch: a rejection request is recorded as a verification
impact: {"decision":"Rejected","competentAuthority":"Automated Rejection Pipeline"} -> 200, row status:"Verified", verifiedBy:"Dr. R. K. Sharma", typed authority string discarded; undertaking arm branches (409/400) proving the document arm is missing

title: A live session can rewrite a shared notification for every reader
location: evidence only - doc cites round 5 P-35; no path:line
impact: EVC_MEMBER PUT /api/notifications/NOTIF-3 -> 200, read=false->true, priority medium->low (seed comparator proved medium); one read column for a multi-role audience makes "mark read" inherently global

title: Unparsable dates accepted into regulated deadline columns
impact: expiryDate:"not-a-date" stored on a Verified document while the UI's own parseDate returns null; only a string<=100 check; ordering consequence measured in lens-L3 (P-48, rolled back)

title: Brute force against non-existent accounts leaves no audit trace
impact: 80 failed logins across distinct unknown emails changed FAILED_LOGIN_BAD_PASSWORD count by 0; every row carries a real userId; credential-stuffing invisible to the one screen an evaluator checks

title: The audit trail can be buried by any session; no read path past row 200
impact: Any session can grow the trail past the readable window; see lens-L3.md 3.13.4

title: PUT /roles/:role/permissions rewrites every user's effective permissions with no audit row
impact: Deliberate no-op body -> 200; role_permissions and USR-EVC-MEMBER.permissions verified unchanged; audit_logs 95->95, no row names the action; matrix is a cache of the ACL, users can be edited to disagree without a trail

title: The real authentication path is a competent implementation - worth saying out loud
impact: randomBytes(32) sha256-lookup sessions, HttpOnly/Lax, scrypt+salt+timingSafeEqual with dummy-hash parity, re-check of revokedAt/expiresAt/isActive per request, throttled login with Retry-After, logout revokes

title: SQL injection: no string SQL
impact: Only $queryRaw is SELECT 1; zero $queryRawUnsafe/$executeRaw*

title: XSS sinks: clean
impact: 0 dangerouslySetInnerHTML, 0 innerHTML=, 0 eval( in src/

title: Password hash never exposed in responses
impact: toUser omits passwordHash; it appears in only 4 server sites, none a response

title: Session token strength
impact: randomBytes(32) base64url, sha256 lookup hash, HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax

title: Password verification
impact: scrypt + random salt + timingSafeEqual + dummy-hash timing parity

title: CSRF: global origin check on every non-GET plus SameSite=Lax
impact: GET handlers only read (single write on a GET is the lastUsedAt touch, session.ts:144-145); /api/admin/reset is a POST; grep + read of 45 handlers

title: Upload integrity
impact: express.raw limit at route, real byte re-check after receipt, uploader-owned key check, key shape validated

title: Download authorization
impact: canRead(uploaderId, scope) on presign and direct read; nosniff + private, no-store

title: Error non-leakage
impact: HttpError maps to {error,text}; unknown errors generic 500, stack never serialized

title: Privileged secrets not in the bundle
impact: DATABASE_URL/SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY/CRON_SECRET/GEMINI_API_KEY only under server/ via process.env; only VITE_SUPABASE_URL/_ANON_KEY via import.meta.env

title: Identity never taken from the body
impact: verifyCaller derives role/scope from DB profile; server routes take actor from req.auth

title: DB port not published
impact: Compose publishes only APP_PORT; Postgres has no ports: mapping in the overlay

title: Model output cannot drive navigation
impact: actionLinks are looked up in a static KB, not emitted by the model; no HTML sink

title: Scope enforcement is consistently enforced - a strength worth protecting
impact: Cross-institute PUT 403, out-of-region EVC visit 403, document verify 403 SCOPE_DENIED, undertaking PUT 403, config/role-permissions writes by non-admin 403

title: Local storage driver authorises correctly
impact: Non-owner PUT 403, other-account complete 403, missing documents.verify 403, unauth 401, ../etc/passwd and /app/etc/passwd keys 400, other users' keys 404, 27MB 413, 0-byte 400; nosniff + no-store on downloads

title: Round-3 storage 500s (PUT /api/files/object 500, GET 404)
impact: Withdrawn: caused by this audit container being created without UPLOAD_DIR; compose sets it (docker-compose.postgres.yml:12-16) and round 4 with correct env got 204/200/400/413. No product defect

title: No resource limits anywhere in either compose file
impact: No mem_limit/cpus/deploy.resources/read_only/no-new-privileges; unbounded GET /api/snapshot (L3-06) can allocate without ceiling and take host and demo down; idle RSS 66MB so headroom fine today
fix: one mem_limit pair on app and db - the cheapest insurance in this lens

title: TypeScript runs with strict disabled for SPA and server
impact: strictNullChecks/noImplicitAny/strictFunctionTypes all off; user.region! (data.ts:511), unvalidated targetRole cast; green npx tsc -b is a much weaker guarantee than it looks; tsconfigs disagree on hygiene flags (8 of 22 lint warnings)
fix: turn strictNullChecks on first (surfaces genuine bugs), full strict last

title: No CI; every gate is a human remembering to run it
impact: No .github/, hooks or verify script; tsc -b/test:run/lint/build documented only in prose; supabase/tests/rls.sql - the sole proof of audit immutability and cross-tenant isolation - has no runner; that is how a false "Done" for append-only audit survived

title: README/dev-loop inaccuracies
impact: Node 20+ claim vs --experimental-strip-types needing >=22.6 (no engines field); overlay rebuild overwrites the demo image; migrate deploy P1012 without .env undocumented; compose environment overrides env_file so the Neon DATABASE_URL is silently ignored; third localStorage namespace typo; CRON_SECRET sweep claim false

title: package.json hygiene
impact: prisma seed config deprecated -> warning on every CLI invocation; no verify/typecheck scripts; prisma CLI in dependencies pulls the only production advisory into the image; happy-dom devDependency unused
fix: move the prisma config to prisma.config.ts (one line)

title: Lint posture: 22 warnings / 0 errors with no owner
impact: rules-of-hooks escalated to error (hook order machine-checked - good); but 22 warnings (set-state-in-effect 5, no-unused-vars 9, only-export-components 3, purity 2 incl. Date.now()/Math.random() in render at AppContext.tsx:396, exhaustive-deps 2, refs 1) unowned because oxlint not wired into CI; zero errors is not clean

title: .gitignore does not cover coverage/
impact: coverage/ written by npm run test:coverage appears as ?? coverage/ in git status right after running the documented test gate (present at Stage 0); it is correctly listed in .dockerignore

title: Committed local Postgres credential pair with no warning in docs
impact: apoorvasetu/apoorvasetu committed; acceptable for the host-internal container (db publishes no ports) but it must never be copy-pasted into a hosted compose file, and nothing in the docs says so
fix: add a docs warning never to reuse the pair in a hosted compose

title: Fresh-clone test: doc records "Deferred to Pass C", no result written
impact: Doc says: "Deferred to Pass C", where a git clone of the pinned commit will run npm install -> npm run build -> docker compose up per README.md:16-55 with output under evidence/raw/; no result recorded; Stage 0 already proves the two first commands fail as README describes

title: Container build mostly right: 5-stage Dockerfile, non-root, no secrets
impact: USER node + chowned layers, HEALTHCHECK, npm cache mount + npm ci, openssl fix, thorough .dockerignore, VITE_* build args unset, init/restart hygiene; caveat: COPY src (:58) ships 30k lines of SPA source incl. the client HMAC secret; 1.07GB image, supabase-js trim candidate
fix: trim candidate: drop @supabase/supabase-js from the Postgres runner
